verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows probes for common OpenAPI spec locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) all returned 404, and no citation shows Stripe publishing a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec; only llms.txt and markdown docs pages exist, which are documentation formats, not a formal API schema. Missing for 10: a documented OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, an official spec download page, or any docs reference to a machine-readable API schema.
